'''Tava''' will be a distant descendant of Aviendha and Rand in one potential future. She is seen by [[Aviendha]] in the [[Glass columns]] of [[Rhuidean]]. 

== Ancestry and potential descent of Tava ==
[[Aviendha]] and [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] ↠ [[Padra]] ↠ [[Oncala]] ↠ [[Ladalin]] ↠ ? ↠ ? ↠ [[Rowahn]] ↠ '''Tava''' ↠ ? ↠ [[Norlesh]] ↠ ? ↠ [[Malidra]]

== History ==

During Aviendha's visions Tava's Hold is destroyed in a Seanchan raid. [[Rowahn]] is her father and [[Norlesh]] is her granddaughter.
